recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片被大量芽細胞佔據（高核質比、細緻染色質、部分細胞質有空泡），箭頭指的是一顆成熟且形態異常的顆粒球，細胞質內有 Auer 小體，而芽細胞本身沒有；搭配流式同時表現 T 與骨髓系標記，符合混合表型急性白血病（MPAL）。
features: Sheets of medium-to-large blasts with high N:C ratio, fine chromatin, and variably prominent nucleoli
Blast cytoplasm is scant to moderate, basophilic, with some vacuoles and cytoplasmic blebs
Nuclei are round to irregular with occasional folding
A mature, dysplastic-appearing granulocyte (arrow) with clumped chromatin containing cytoplasmic inclusions reported as Auer rods (rod detail limited at this resolution)
Mitotic figure present; scant residual normal hematopoiesis
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear is replaced by a population of medium-to-large blasts with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio, fine chromatin, variably prominent nucleoli, irregular or folded nuclei, and scant basophilic, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. A mitotic figure is present. A mature, dysplastic-appearing granulocyte (arrow) contains cytoplasmic Auer rods, whereas Auer rods are not seen within the blasts; the rods themselves are difficult to resolve at this image resolution. Morphology alone cannot assign lineage; with flow cytometry showing TdT/CD34-positive blasts co-expressing cytoplasmic CD3 and myeloid markers, findings are consistent with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, T/myeloid.

ddx.vs: AML with maturation shows MPO-positive myeloblasts often containing Auer rods themselves and lacks cytoplasmic CD3 expression.

ddx.dx: T-lymphoblastic leukemia with aberrant myeloid antigens
ddx.vs: T-ALL may express CD13/CD33 but does not show MPO positivity or Auer rods, which would indicate true myeloid lineage.
ETP-ALL is CD1a-/CD8-, CD5 dim, with stem/myeloid markers but is MPO negative and lacks Auer rods.

ddx.dx: Therapy-related or MDS-related AML with dysplastic granulocytes
ddx.vs: Dysplastic maturing granulocytes with Auer rods also occur in myelodysplasia-related AML, which is separated by lineage-defining flow and cytogenetics.
